login.title: Sign in

invitation.notYou: Not you? Ignore this invitation; it expires on its own.
invitation.emailHelp: From your invitation; cannot be changed here.
invitation.passwordHelp: Use a long password that you do not use elsewhere.
invitation.passwordRejected: Error: the password is too short. Use a longer password.
invitation.mismatch: Error: the two passwords do not match.
invitation.invalidTitle: This invitation link cannot be used
invitation.invalidBody: The link is not valid: it may have expired, been used already or been withdrawn.
invitation.askAdmin: Ask your organisation's administrator for a new invitation.
invitation.signInIfAccount: Sign in if you already have an account.

invitation.seatAskAdmin: Ask your administrator to free a seat, then open this link again.
invitation.signedInBody: Sign out before you open an invitation link.

workspace.title: Profiles
workspace.loadError: Error: the profiles could not be loaded. Try again; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.

refusalShort.quota_reached: New runs are refused: your organisation has used its profile quota.
refusalShort.access_ended: New runs are refused: your organisation's access has ended.
refusalShort.not_activated: New runs are refused: your organisation is not activated yet.
refusalShort.spend_cap_reached: New runs are refused: this instance has reached its monthly limit.

refusalLong.quota_reached: New profile runs are refused because your organisation has used its profile quota. Your existing profiles remain readable, and you can still compare them and download them as PDF. Your administrator can tell you how to continue.
refusalLong.access_ended: New profile runs are refused because your organisation's access ended on {{date}}. Your existing profiles remain readable, and you can still compare them and download them as PDF.
refusalLong.not_activated: New profile runs are refused because your organisation has not been activated yet. Your existing profiles remain readable. Your administrator can tell you how to continue.
refusalLong.spend_cap_reached: New profile runs are refused because this instance has reached its configured monthly limit for AI usage. Your existing profiles remain readable, and you can still compare them and download them as PDF. New runs are possible again next month, or earlier if the administrator raises the limit.

workspace.emptyIntro: Your organisation has no supplier profile yet. A profile is built in three steps:
workspace.emptyStep1: You name the supplier; the assistant proposes the most likely company and you confirm its identity.
workspace.emptyStep2: The profile run collects public evidence in the background and fills the profile; every fact carries its quote, source and date.
workspace.emptyStep3: You review each fact and each assessment statement: the AI proposes, you decide.
workspace.caption: Your organisation's supplier profiles, newest first
workspace.compareWhy: Tick two or more profiles to compare them side by side.

placeholder.admin: The administrator area will appear here.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist, or the item you asked for is not available.

failure.title: Something went wrong
failure.body: The page could not be displayed. Reload it; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.

newProfile.name: Supplier name
newProfile.nameHelp: The company's usual or legal name, in any script.
newProfile.hintsHelp: Hints change the order of the candidates only; they never exclude one.
newProfile.websiteHelp: If you know it. The assistant checks that the site responds.
newProfile.unavailable: Error: the search could not start. Try again in a few minutes.

chat.title: Confirm the supplier
chat.disclosureFailed: the assistant could not be started, so no conversation is possible yet.
chat.agentUnavailable: The assistant is not available right now. Nothing was lost; try again in a few minutes.
chat.noneOfThese: None of these, enter the website
chat.othersIntro: Here are the other candidates, in order of how well they match your search and hint. A hint never removes a candidate.
chat.checkRecord: Please check the identity record below. The profile run starts only after you confirm it.
chat.confirm: Confirm and start the profile run
chat.websiteHelp: For example ardentis-france.example. The assistant checks that it responds; private-network addresses are refused.
chat.replyHelp: Correct or add details, for example “no, the French subsidiary” or “their site is …”.

refused.quota_reached: The profile quota of your organisation is used up, so no new profile run can start. The supplier is confirmed and kept; ask your administrator about the quota.
refused.access_ended: Your organisation's access period has ended, so no new profile run can start. Existing profiles stay readable.
refused.not_activated: Your organisation is not activated yet, so no profile run can start. The supplier is confirmed and kept.
refused.spend_cap_reached: The monthly limit on AI spend of this service is reached, so no new profile run can start before next month. The supplier is confirmed and kept.
refused.unknown: The profile run was refused. The supplier is confirmed and kept; try again later.

run.stopRequested: Stop requested: the run ends at the end of the current step.
run.stopBody: The run stops now and cannot be resumed. To profile {{name}} later, you start a new run.
run.stopBodyNoName: The run stops now and cannot be resumed. To profile this supplier later, you start a new run.
run.stopFinished: The run had already finished, so it could not be stopped. The status shown is up to date.
run.stopFailed: The run could not be stopped. Try again; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.
run.resumeNotPaused: The run is no longer paused. The status shown is up to date.
run.resumeFailed: The run could not be resumed. Try again; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.
run.loadError: Error: the run could not be loaded. Try again; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.
run.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. The progress shown may be out of date; the page keeps trying.

summary.failed: The run failed during stage {{n}} of 4 ({{stage}}).
summary.insufficient_sources: The run ended at stage {{n}} of 4 ({{stage}}).
summary.partial: The run ended at stage {{n}} of 4 ({{stage}}) with part of the profile not done.

detail.noUsable: No usable source after every strategy was tried

pauseReason.structuring_provider: The structuring provider (the AI service that reads the sources and extracts the facts) is unavailable.
pauseReason.retrieval_provider: The retrieval provider (the web search service) is unavailable.

run.pausedBody: The run is paused at the {{stage}} stage; the work done so far is kept. Resume the run when you are ready. If the service is still not responding, the run pauses again and nothing is lost.
run.excludedLabel: source excluded at the site owner's request
run.excludedBody: was not collected. The other sources are collected as usual.
run.failureLogIntro: Each failed attempt, the strategy tried and the next strategy chosen.
run.noFailures: No failures: every attempt so far succeeded.
run.failuresUnknown: The failure log could not be loaded. It is read again at the next refresh.

kind.http_error: The server answered with an error
kind.unreachable: The address could not be reached
kind.empty_content: The page was empty once fetched
kind.blocked_by_robots: Not collected: the site's crawl rules do not allow it
kind.not_a_page: Not a page or document that can be read
kind.invalid_response: The service returned an answer that could not be used

run.insufficientBody: No usable public source was collected, so the run ended without a profile. It does not count against your organisation's quota, and it says nothing about the supplier. The failure log below shows what was tried.
run.insufficientLink: Check the website and start a new profile
run.stoppedNote: This profile run was stopped{{when}}. It cannot be resumed; to profile this supplier, start a new profile.
run.failedBody: The run did not finish. The sources and results stored so far are kept.
run.partialBody: The run reached its cost budget and stopped. What was done is kept. The sections below were not examined: that says nothing about the supplier, and it does not mean “No public evidence found”.
run.completedNote: The run is complete. The supplier card is ready.
run.quotaNote: Runs that end in “insufficient sources” do not count against the quota.
run.leaveNote: You can leave this page: the run continues in the background and its status appears in the profile list.

card.loadError: Error: the supplier card could not be loaded. Try again; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.
card.inProgress: This profile run is still going, so there is no supplier card yet.
card.noProfile: This profile run ended without a profile (status: {{status}}), so there is no supplier card.
card.openProgress: See the progress of the run
card.keyFiguresHelp: Key figures, repeating facts of this card
card.author: Author
card.notCoveredField: Not covered by this run: it stopped before this field (partial).
card.notCoveredSection: Not covered by this run: it stopped before this section (partial).
card.aboutPeople: About people: never used in the assessment
card.identityToVerifyBody: Nothing collected confirms the identity: the confirmed name “{{name}}” was not found in the content collected from the supplier's website, or the website gave no content. Check that this website belongs to the company you confirmed before relying on its facts.
card.partialBody: This run stopped when it reached its cost budget. Sections not covered: {{sections}}. They were not examined, which says nothing about the supplier.
card.naturalPerson: The assessment is not prepared for this supplier because of its legal form. This says nothing about the supplier.
card.quoteTitleOriginal: Quote for the original AI value · {{field}}

review.help: The original AI value and its Quote stay on the card next to your correction.
review.invalid: Error: this value cannot be saved. Check that it is not too long and try again.
review.conflict: {{who}} changed this fact on {{date}}. Nothing was overwritten. Its current state is shown above.
review.conflictTyped: {{who}} changed this fact on {{date}}, while you were editing. Nothing was overwritten. Its current state is shown above; your text is kept below.
review.error: Error: the review could not be saved. The row is unchanged. Try again in a few minutes.
review.gone: This fact no longer exists. Reload the card to see its current state.
review.rejected: This fact can no longer be reviewed in this way. Reload the card to see its current state.
review.locked: The profile run is still in progress, so facts cannot be reviewed yet. Try again when it has finished.
review.countNone: No fact is waiting for review.

assessment.citedCorrected: Cites a fact you corrected since this draft: {{facts}}. The text above still reflects the AI value.
assessment.willReplace: Not reviewed: the redraft will replace this draft.
assessment.willKeep: Reviewed: the redraft leaves it unchanged.
assessment.deleteBody: It disappears from the assessment and the PDF. It stays in the profile's history with your name and the time.
assessment.invalidText: Error: this text cannot be saved. Check that it is not too long and try again.
assessment.correctHelp: Cited facts stay attached. The AI text is kept in the statement's provenance.
assessment.conflict: {{who}} changed this statement on {{date}}. Nothing was overwritten. Its current state is shown.
assessment.conflictTyped: {{who}} changed this statement on {{date}}, while you were editing. Nothing was overwritten. Its current state is shown above; your text is kept below.
assessment.error: Error: the review could not be saved. The statement is unchanged. Try again in a few minutes.
assessment.gone: This statement no longer exists. Reload the card to see its current state.
assessment.rejected: This statement can no longer be reviewed in this way. Reload the card to see its current state.
assessment.locked: The profile run is still in progress, so statements cannot be reviewed yet. Try again when it has finished.
assessment.lede: Drafted from the facts of this profile. Each statement cites the facts it relies on or names the evidence that is missing. There is no overall score.
assessment.partialBody: The run stopped when it reached its cost budget, so the assessment is incomplete. What is missing was not examined, which says nothing about the supplier.
assessment.pending: The assessment is still being prepared. It appears here when it is ready.
assessment.loadError: Error: the assessment could not be loaded. Try again; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.
assessment.contextChanged: Buyer context changed since this draft
assessment.contextChangedBody: Drafted with buyer context version {{drafted}}. Version {{current}} is stored now. The recommendations below may no longer match it.
assessment.contextChangedFirst: Drafted on the first-evaluation assumption. A buyer context has been saved since. The recommendations below may no longer match it.
assessment.draftingHelp: You can keep reading; the drafts appear here when they are ready.
assessment.redraftHelp: Replaces the drafts you have not reviewed. Reviewed recommendations stay unchanged. A deleted recommendation is not redrafted.
assessment.nothingNew: No new draft was added. This happens when every item is already reviewed, or when the drafting did not complete. Nothing was changed.
assessment.noRecommendations: No recommendation is shown. Redraft to ask for new drafts.
assessment.fitEmpty: Enter your criteria to assess fit
assessment.criteriaLabel: Your fit criteria for this supplier
assessment.criteriaPlaceholder: For example: EN 9100 certified; five-axis titanium machining; delivery to Hamburg within 6 weeks
assessment.criteriaHelp: One criterion per line. Used only for this profile. Fit statements are drafted only against what you enter here.
assessment.criteriaInvalid: Error: the criteria cannot be saved. Check that they are not too long.
assessment.criteriaConflict: {{who}} saved other criteria on {{date}}. Nothing was overwritten. They are listed below; your text is kept in the field.
assessment.criteriaConflictNone: Someone saved other criteria in the meantime. Nothing was overwritten; your text is kept in the field.
assessment.saveError: Error: it could not be saved. Nothing changed. Try again in a few minutes.
assessment.draftFitHelp: Drafting uses one AI call; the result replaces the fit statements you have not reviewed.
assessment.fitQueued: Drafting of the fit statements started.

problems.spendCap: The monthly limit on AI spend of this service is reached, so nothing can be drafted before next month. Your statements and inputs are kept.
problems.naturalPerson: This business is not assessed because of its legal form. This says nothing about the supplier.
problems.noCriteria: Enter your criteria to assess fit.
problems.budget: The run reached its cost budget; no further AI call is made for it.
problems.notDrafted: The assessment has not been drafted yet. Try again when it appears.
problems.refused: The drafting was refused. Nothing was changed; try again later.
problems.unavailable: Error: the drafting could not be requested. Nothing was changed. Try again in a few minutes.

assessment.buyerLede: Written by members of your organisation. Never generated or changed by AI, and never sent to an AI provider for drafting.
assessment.inputProblem: Error: some buyer input could not be saved. See the messages under the fields; your text is kept.
assessment.inputInvalid: Error: this text cannot be saved. Check that it is not too long.
assessment.inputConflict: {{who}} saved this field on {{date}}. Nothing was overwritten. The text stored now is shown below; yours is kept in the field.
assessment.inputConflictNone: Someone saved this field in the meantime. Nothing was overwritten; your text is kept.

fin.exampleBody: The country rows behind this guidance come from the example table shipped with the product. They are placeholders and have not been verified: do not rely on them.
fin.notConfigured: No registry guidance is configured for this country.
fin.caption: Documents for financial year {{year}}

accessStatus.registry_unavailable: Registry not reachable (this does not show that no filing exists)

missingKinds.supplier_entity_accounts: Supplier-entity accounts rather than group accounts

fin.neverBought: paid documents are linked, never bought

assessment.fitDone: Fit statements drafted. They are below, pending your validation.
assessment.recoDone: Recommendations drafted. They are below, pending your validation.

context.title: Buyer context
context.optional: only the supplier status is required
context.kicker: Buyer context · entered by you, not drafted by the AI
context.lede: Describe your own situation with this supplier. It is entered by you and stored as you wrote it; it is not an AI statement. The AI uses it only to draft recommendations and never adds to it. Personal data in the notes is redacted before any AI call.
context.lastSaved: Last saved by {{who}} on {{date}} (version {{version}}). This save creates version {{next}}.
context.conflict: {{who}} saved a newer buyer context on {{date}}. Nothing was overwritten. It is shown below; your entries are kept in the form. Save again to replace it.
context.conflictNone: Someone saved a newer buyer context in the meantime. Nothing was overwritten; your entries are kept in the form.
context.saveError: Error: the buyer context could not be saved. Nothing changed. Try again in a few minutes.
context.statusHelp: Is this supplier already one of yours?
context.share: Current share of your category spend (%)
context.shareHelp: The part of your spend in this category that goes to this supplier today.
context.shareError: Enter a number from 0 to 100, for example 12.
context.endError: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2027-03-31.
context.notesHelp: Free text. Do not enter names of people.
context.notesError: These notes cannot be saved. Check that they are not too long.
context.afterSave: After saving, press “Redraft recommendations” to use the new version.
context.noneBody: These recommendations assume a first evaluation of this supplier. Add your context (incumbent or new, share of spend, contract end, intent) to tailor them to your situation.
context.savedAnnounce: Buyer context saved (version {{version}}). Redraft the recommendations to use it.

pdf.error: Error: the PDF could not be generated. Nothing was changed. Try again in a few minutes.
pdf.inProgress: The profile run is still in progress, so there is no card to export yet.
pdf.unavailableInProgress: Available when the run has finished.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.intro: Profiles side by side, aligned field by field.
compare.introMatrix: Compact matrix for 5 or more profiles. The table scrolls sideways inside its own frame; the field column stays in place.
compare.legendApproved: decided by a member, not an independent verification
compare.legendChip: Source chip: opens the Quote under the value
compare.tooFew: Choose at least two profiles to compare.
compare.range: A comparison takes between 2 and {{maximum}} profiles. Go back to the workspace to change the selection.
compare.maximumReached: Configured maximum for one comparison reached ({{maximum}}). Untick a profile to choose another.
compare.loadError: Error: the comparison could not be loaded. Try again; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.

demo.noAccount: No account needed. Read-only: pre-built profiles, comparison and PDF.
demo.landingLede: Name a supplier and confirm its identity. Supplier iScan collects public evidence and fills a fixed profile in which every fact carries a verbatim quote, its source and date, or “No public evidence found”. The AI proposes; the buyer decides.
demo.pointQuoted: A verbatim quote, the source and the date, checked against the stored source text.
demo.pointGaps: Missing information reads “No public evidence found”, never a negative claim.
demo.pointDecides: Facts and assessment drafts stay proposals until a member approves or corrects them.
demo.listIntro: Pre-built, read-only profiles of fictional companies. Tick 2 or more to compare them.
demo.newProfileWhy: Not available in the demo: a new profile would call an AI provider.
demo.caption: Demo supplier profiles, newest first
demo.emptyBody: The demo has no profile at the moment. Come back later, or sign in if your organisation has an account.
demo.loadError: Error: the demo profiles could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
demo.readOnlyReason: Demo profiles are read-only: re-run, review and criteria would call an AI provider or change the profile.
demo.noStatements: No statement in this part of the demo profile.
